findings.observed: Add-to-cart sits below three scroll-lengths of copy; no sticky ATC on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Test a sticky mobile add-to-cart bar so the CTA is always visible.

findings.observed: No subscription cancellation terms or money-back guarantee near the buy box.
findings.recommendation: Add a 30-day guarantee + 'cancel anytime' microcopy beside the ATC.

findings.observed: Hero leads with a lifestyle image; benefit headline is below the fold.
findings.recommendation: Test a benefit-led headline + star rating in the first viewport.

findings.observed: Cart drawer hides the shipping threshold progress until checkout.
findings.recommendation: Surface free-shipping progress + threshold in the cart drawer.

rows.question_or_complaint: How do I pause or cancel my subscription?
rows.site_gap: Subscription terms not shown on PDP — add a 'cancel/pause anytime' explainer.

rows.question_or_complaint: Does one tub really last 30 days?
rows.site_gap: Add servings-per-tub + cost-per-serving to the PDP.
Set delivery expectations in cart + show est. delivery date.

near_abandonment: Couldn't tell how the subscription billing worked

rows.observed: Ads lead with founder story + third-party testing; PDP shows neither above the fold.
rows.gap: Add founder story + testing badge to the PDP hero to match the ad promise.

rows.observed: 6 sitewide sales in the last 6 months.
rows.gap: Likely training customers to wait for discounts — test reducing sale frequency.

rows.observed: Free shipping at $75; hero product is $84.90.
rows.gap: Threshold sits just under AOV — fine, but test a single-unit bundle to lift it.

messaging_gaps: No competitor leads with taste as the hero angle — reviews show taste is our #1 driver. Test a 'tastes great' hero.
We're the only brand without a visible guarantee above the fold.

findings.title: No sticky add-to-cart on mobile PDP
findings.evidence: ATC below 3 scroll-lengths; 82% of sessions are mobile and mobile CVR (1.9%) trails desktop (4.1%).
findings.recommendation: Test a sticky mobile ATC bar on the hero PDP (41% of all sessions land here).

findings.title: Subscription terms unclear
findings.evidence: Triangulated: 14% of reviews mention subscription confusion, it's a top support question, and a top survey near-abandonment factor.
findings.recommendation: Add 'pause or cancel anytime' + billing cadence explainer beside the ATC.

findings.title: Ad-to-PDP message mismatch
findings.evidence: Ads sell founder story + third-party testing; PDP hero shows neither. Survey buyers cite both as triggers.
findings.recommendation: Add founder story + testing badge to the PDP hero to reinforce the ad promise.

findings.title: No guarantee or 'tastes great' angle above the fold
findings.evidence: Taste is the #1 review driver (38%) yet no competitor uses it as the hero angle; we also lack a visible guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Test a benefit-led 'tastes great' hero + 30-day guarantee badge.

findings.title: Shipping threshold hidden until checkout
findings.evidence: Cart drawer hides free-shipping progress; checkout abandonment is elevated.
findings.recommendation: Show free-shipping progress bar + threshold in the cart drawer.

findings.title: Heavy sale cadence may cannibalize full-price CVR
findings.evidence: 6 sitewide sales in 6 months — repeat visitors may be trained to wait.
findings.recommendation: Test reducing sale frequency and leading with value framing instead.
